# OK tone

## Purpose

A valid block that other fixtures refer to.

## Must include

- Plain words.

## Avoid

- Jargon.

## Examples

Good:
```text
## Not a heading, because it is inside a fence
```

## Done when

- [must] Uses plain words. (learned 2026-11-01)
